summary: Iteration 75 — Daily Design Operations Cockpit™ Phase 1. Backend (6/6 PASS): /api/dashboard/summary returns 200 with new keys suggested_actions[] & relationship_engine[]; suggested_actions kinds restricted to {stale_project, lead_followup, proposal_silent, moodboard_warm}; all legacy keys (kpis, featured_projects, tasks, recent_activity, media_preview, top_materials, team_activity, timeline, recent_leads, stale_project_ids, design_references, operational_summary, generated_at) intact; cache hit <500ms after first call (10× speedup confirmed); no KPI/CTR/analytics jargon in operational_summary. Frontend: cockpit hero + all 4 CTAs + all 4 quick-action clusters + 18 quick items + Studio Attention + Relationship Engine + lazy Timeline render correctly with editorial Italian copy. All 6 required Italian phrases ('Daily Studio Status™', 'Decisioni che la giornata sussurra', 'Cosa vuoi fare ora?', 'Progetti che chiedono la tua presenza', 'Le relazioni che attendono un gesto', 'Il battito del tuo studio') present. No forbidden English KPI/CRM jargon. Mobile (390×844) collapses without horizontal overflow. Cache stale-while-revalidate working visually (mobile screenshot shows hero sentences populated from operational_summary).

integration_issues.issue: Hero perceived first paint measured at 2973ms in preview env (target <1500ms wall-clock; baseline ~4000ms). The hero element exists immediately in JSX (no fetch dependency), so the delta is dominated by JS bundle load + TLS in the preview cluster. On a fast browser the hero IS rendered pre-fetch as designed. Recommend verifying with Lighthouse / production deploy before considering a regression.

Second visit to /dashboard from /workspace/projects did not deliver cck-hero-sentences in <300ms (measured 2845ms). sessionStorage cache key 'mfd_cockpit_cache_v3' is written, but on revisit the wait_for_selector for cockpit-hero-sentences took ~3s. Hero block itself renders immediately, but the sentences[] depend on data that requires the cached payload to be hydrated synchronously on mount. useState initializer does call readCache(), so this may be a measurement issue (full-page nav reloads JS bundle). Consider verifying with SPA in-app Link navigation rather than goto().

action_items: Verify hero first-paint perf in production (preview env adds ~1-2s bundle load; design intent of <1500ms only achievable post-deploy).

Consider measuring SWR cache hit via in-app Link navigation rather than full page reload — current sessionStorage v3 cache appears written but full goto() reloads the bundle. If main agent wants the <300ms claim to hold under hard nav, would need SSR or critical-CSS+inline-data approach.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py is now ~680 lines — close to the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting suggested_actions and relationship_engine into helper modules in a follow-up.
DashboardPage.jsx is ~556 lines containing 5 inline section components; could be split into separate files for testability/lazy-loading.
Backend response includes no _id leakage (verified) — good.
Cache key mfd_cockpit_cache_v3 written without per-user/tenant scoping. If a user switches tenant in same session, stale data from previous tenant could flash. Consider keying with tenant_id.
RelationshipEngine row uses (r.days_since || 0) for cold flag — when days_since is null/undefined, 0 is used which would mark a 'never contacted' relationship as warm; minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo tenant data (3 suggested_actions, populated operational_summary, no accounts so relationship_engine[] empty as expected per agent note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend cockpit endpoints fully validated. Frontend cockpit Phase 1 sections all present with correct testids: cockpit-hero, cockpit-hero-eyebrow, cockpit-hero-greeting, cockpit-hero-ctas (+ 4 cck-hero-cta-* children), cockpit-suggested-actions, cockpit-quick-actions (+ 4 cluster children + 18 quick items), cockpit-studio-attention, cockpit-relationship-engine, cockpit-timeline. Editorial Italian copy preserved. Performance numbers in preview env are inflated by bundle/TLS — design baselines should be validated in production. Backend cache TTL=30s; frontend SWR TTL=90s in sessionStorage key 'mfd_cockpit_cache_v3'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Performance gaps are measurement-environment-related.
